gap: RASTER_READ_WRITE_PROFILE_SAFE_SMOKE_PASS is required by the Candidate shared runtime promotion contract, but current verified evidence only proves deterministic PNG generation and dimension readback.
required_native_output: ICC-bearing raster derivative whose embedded profile survives a deterministic resize roundtrip and can be extracted/read back with identical profile bytes.

capability_probe.delegates: bzlib cairo fontconfig freetype jbig jng jpeg lzma pangocairo png rsvg tiff webp xml zlib zstd

actual_attack.attempt: Create 320x180 gradient, attach sRGB ICC profile, reopen/extract embedded profile, resize to 160x90, extract profile again, compare profile hashes.
actual_attack.observed_failure: ImageMagick warned that LCMS delegate support is not built in; the output contained no extractable color profile.

root_cause: The current materialized ImageMagick build lacks the LCMS delegate required for ICC profile application/conversion. File generation and pixel-dimension readback therefore cannot prove profile-safe raster handling.

repair.behavior: Before any ICC-dependent smoke, verify ImageMagick availability, ICC source availability, and LCMS delegate. If LCMS is absent, return HOLD with exit code 78 instead of silently treating raster generation as profile-safe PASS. If available, execute attach -> resize -> extract -> hash-compare -> dimension readback.

proven: The current execution surface exposes ImageMagick 7.1.2-1.
The current ImageMagick build lacks LCMS in its delegate list.
ICC-dependent profile safety is not proven by the existing raster smoke.
A fail-closed preflight can prevent false profile-safe PASS claims.
not_proven: ICC profile preservation on a LCMS-capable shared runner
transfer_boundary: Use this validator only when the requested raster workflow depends on embedded ICC/profile semantics. Ordinary geometry/dimension-only PNG generation may still use the raster wrapper, but must not be described as profile-safe. Production color work remains HOLD until a LCMS-capable runtime and applicable print/display validation are executed.
promotion_effect: NONE; the Candidate shared runtime remains Candidate and RASTER_READ_WRITE_PROFILE_SAFE_SMOKE_PASS remains OPEN.
